changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE clinlims.micro_incoming_item ADD CONSTRAINT micro_incoming_source CHECK(source IN ('ANALYZER','REFERRAL')); ALTER TABLE clinlims.micro_incoming_item ADD CONSTRAINT micro_incoming_state CHECK(state IN ('WAITING','PLACED','FAILED','NEEDS_AMENDMENT'));

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM clinlims.label_preset WHERE lower(name)=lower('Culture Plate Label')

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.label_preset (id,name,height_mm,width_mm,barcode_type,prints_per_order,prints_per_sample,prints_per_container,default_per_order,max_per_order,default_per_sample,max_per_sample,default_per_container,max_per_container,is_system,is_active,is_universal) SELECT nextval('clinlims.label_preset_seq'),'Culture Plate Label',25,50,'QR',false,false,true,0,10,0,10,0,10,true,true,false WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.label_preset WHERE lower(name)=lower('Culture Plate Label'));
INSERT INTO clinlims.micro_container_preset_seed(preset_id) SELECT id FROM clinlims.label_preset WHERE name='Culture Plate Label';

delete.where: name='Culture Plate Label' AND is_system=true AND id IN (SELECT preset_id FROM clinlims.micro_container_preset_seed)

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM clinlims.micro_container_preset_seed WHERE preset_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM clinlims.label_preset);
